events.name: Ballet Virginia: Coppelia
events.info: Join Ballet Virginia for this beloved comic ballet, a delightful performance the whole family will enjoy. You'll be enchanted by Dr. Coppelius's charming, life-like doll, Coppélia, and the hilarious mix-ups that follow. Filled with young love, playful jealousy, mistaken identities, and plenty of mischief, this charming story will keep audiences smiling from beginning to end. With true love triumphing in the end, beautiful music by Delibes, and exquisite choreography performed by Ballet Virginia's professional company, Coppélia is a magical ballet experience you won't want to miss. For the enjoyment of all patrons, children under 3 are not permitted to attend.

events.info: 6:30PM Doors / 8:00PM Show. The Best of Steve Martin & Martin Short is a show that redefines the form in unexpected and profound ways, from two of the funniest, most influential and acclaimed talents of the past century. Their humor is often subversive, but it is always a joyous self-deprecating romp from two comedy masters driven to make each other laugh as much as the audience. The jokes come at you at a rapid-fire pace with little set-up and big punch lines as they mock Hollywood and the fickle nature of celebrity, but the comedy truly soars when they lovingly (and relentlessly) roast each other. Martin and Short?s chemistry and timing on stage reflects a friendship forged over three decades which developed when they met for the first time on the set of the 1986 film ?Three Amigos.? These two titans of comedy have been touring together since 2015, when they launched their first live show entitled ?A Very Stupid Conversation.?
